discussion_comments.comment_body:
Half fixed, half deliberately deferred.

The surrogate split is real and fixed in a69494cdd: the cut is now on code points, so an astral character can't be halved into a replacement glyph.

The column-width part I'd rather not fix here. `.length`-based pre-truncation is the pattern `AGENTS.md` itself prescribes, and it is used at seven sites across `ui/text` (`toolcall.tsx:47`, `tui.tsx:176`, `tui.tsx:294`, `configure.tsx:206`, `configure.tsx:307`, `onboarding.tsx:224`, plus this one). Doing it properly means adding `string-width`/`cli-truncate` as direct dependencies and converting all of them — plus the guidance in `AGENTS.md` — which is its own PR rather than a rider on a header change.

Worth noting the exposure is bounded: the `<Text>` carries `wrap="truncate-end"`, and Ink truncates by terminal cells via `cli-truncate`, so a wide-character label gets cut a column late rather than overflowing. Happy to open that follow-up if you'd like it.
**Fixed in a1b8b59.** Good catch. Now splits on both `/` and `\` so Windows paths like `C:\Users\me\repo` are correctly parsed.
